tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The page. White, decided by Nimish on 9 Nov 2026 (docs/decisions/2026-11-09-white-ground-for-the-site.md).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: A rail box, a sunken strip, the head of a table, the segmented tabs. One step off the ground.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: A card, a period row, a details block: it sits on the ground with shadow-card, not a border.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All text and icons that carry no kind or state. Never pure black.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Purpose lines, captions, column heads, the second line of a row.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows inside a card. Decoration only: never the edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: The edge of an input, a select, the not-seen node of the child graph. 3:1 or better on ground.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links, always underlined. Never the colour of a state.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2 px focus ring, offset 2 px, on anything a keyboard reaches.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: The row of the current period, and the hovered row of a table.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: The one main action on a page: a filled button. Also the 'now' outline on a period and the selected day.

tokens.name: action-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icon on the main action.

tokens.name: brand-clay
tokens.usage: The school's terracotta: the mark, the active door's underline. Never a state, never on a child.

tokens.name: brand-basalt
tokens.usage: The wordmark. The main action uses the action token.

tokens.name: brand-olive
tokens.usage: A brand material only; green states use state-ok.

tokens.name: brand-bamboo
tokens.usage: A brand material only; amber states use state-wait.

tokens.name: brand-haldi
tokens.usage: A brand material; the source of the Arts hue (see subject-arts). Never a border or text on white (about 2.2:1).

tokens.name: brand-monsoon
tokens.usage: A brand material only; Numeracy uses subject-numeracy.

tokens.name: brand-bark
tokens.usage: A brand material only; Language uses subject-language.

tokens.name: brand-sand
tokens.usage: A brand material only; the fixed parts of the day use subject-fixed-bg.

tokens.name: state-ok
tokens.usage: Text and icon of a green state: done, secure, right, results in, live. Always with its word.

tokens.name: state-ok-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind a green chip, tile or child's square.

tokens.name: state-wait
tokens.usage: Text and icon of an amber state: waiting, to confirm, this week, drafted, moved, practising, wrong.

tokens.name: state-wait-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind an amber chip, tile or child's square.

tokens.name: state-late
tokens.usage: Text and icon of a red state: do now, late, a clash, for you to judge. Work only; a child is never red.

tokens.name: state-late-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind a red chip or tile. Rare on any screen.

tokens.name: state-quiet
tokens.usage: Text and icon of a grey state: to do, not seen, blank, emerging, absent.

tokens.name: state-quiet-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind a grey chip or child's square.

tokens.name: kind-period
tokens.usage: Period, fortnight, timetable: the icon in its tile, a card header's icon. Slate.

tokens.name: kind-period-bg
tokens.usage: The tile and tinted card header of a period or fortnight.

tokens.name: kind-child
tokens.usage: A child: the initials disc, the child graph's centre, its tile. Teal.

tokens.name: kind-child-bg
tokens.usage: The tile and tinted card header of a child.

tokens.name: kind-activity
tokens.usage: An activity. Indigo.

tokens.name: kind-activity-bg
tokens.usage: The tile and tinted card header of an activity.

tokens.name: kind-objective
tokens.usage: A learning objective. Violet.

tokens.name: kind-objective-bg
tokens.usage: The tile and tinted card header of an objective.

tokens.name: kind-skill
tokens.usage: A skill. Orchid.

tokens.name: kind-skill-bg
tokens.usage: The tile and tinted card header of a skill.

tokens.name: kind-assessment
tokens.usage: An assessment or a child's paper. Sky.

tokens.name: kind-assessment-bg
tokens.usage: The tile and tinted card header of an assessment or paper.

tokens.name: kind-note
tokens.usage: A note (voice or typed) and materials. Stone.

tokens.name: kind-note-bg
tokens.usage: The tile and tinted card header of a note or a materials list.

tokens.name: subject-numeracy
tokens.usage: The top edge, icon and word of a Numeracy period or timetable cell.

tokens.name: subject-numeracy-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of a Numeracy cell and its icon tile.

tokens.name: subject-language
tokens.usage: The top edge, icon and word of a Language period or cell.

tokens.name: subject-language-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of a Language cell and its icon tile.

tokens.name: subject-arts
tokens.usage: The top edge of an Arts or Music cell (the haldi family, 3:1 on white).

tokens.name: subject-arts-ink
tokens.usage: The icon and word of an Arts or Music cell (4.5:1 on its fill).

tokens.name: subject-arts-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of an Arts or Music cell and its icon tile.

tokens.name: subject-fixed
tokens.usage: Text of the fixed parts of the day: settling, fruit, lunch, going home.

tokens.name: subject-fixed-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of a fixed part of the day: a full-width band on the timetable, a quiet row on Today.

fonts.note: No Devanagari: Source Sans 3 has none. Nothing in Devanagari is rendered today; if the school wants it, that is a decision for Nimish, and a fallback font is then added.

styles.name: title-page
styles.usage: The one h1 of a page.

styles.name: title-section
styles.usage: A section or card title that names a thing.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Your periods in order. Tap one for what to teach.
styles.usage: The purpose line under a title; at most 140 characters.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Counts 20 and says how many without recounting.
styles.usage: Everything a person reads. Never smaller for a status, a label or an action.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Chips, buttons, tabs, column heads, the rail.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: The one line above a title that says what kind of thing this is and carries its facts (state, count, class). 14 px because it can carry a status.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps and sources only. Never a status or an action.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between an icon and its word, inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between rows in a list, between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside a card; the side gutter on a phone.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between blocks of a page; the main column's padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Above a new section.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between the title block and the first block of work.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page bottom.

tokens.name: tap
tokens.usage: The least height and width of anything tappable.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, period rows, timetable cells, a child's square, the rail box.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, tabs, icon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: A state chip, the count badge, a name chip.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: The one elevation: a card, a period row, the selected tab. It replaces the card's border. Never on a chip, text or a tinted square.

tokens.name: press
tokens.usage: The only motion on the site: anything pressable gives way on :active. Hover changes colour only, on a fine pointer. Under prefers-reduced-motion it is removed.
